title: [BTWR Component] Hardcore Mob Tweaks
description: Tweaks mobs to be more automatable for BTW-style mob farms
body:
This mini-mod tweaks mobs in ways that supplements BTW-style automation
## Changes:
- Mobs will always wander, no matter what
- Mobs will not immediately despawn if player is too far away

## Acknowledgment
This mod ports features from the Better Than Wolves Mod, which was created by FlowerChild and is currently maintained by the CE Team. Link to the original mod -> [here](https://btwce.com).
